\begin{frame}{Appendix: making the live demo safe}
\subt{\chg{Continue from Lesson 1: the short scripts, then Sportello Italia, then the Brain around that project.}}
\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{0.32em}\small
\item \chg{\textbf{Open the Brain.} Show the real folder: shared rules, one folder per project, and how that structure was built.}
\item \chg{\textbf{Ingest.} File the Sportello Italia notes into that project: state, decisions, sources.}
\item \chg{\textbf{Reopen.} Start a new session on the project and walk through the parts the agent actually reads.}
\item \chg{\textbf{Close.} Run the closeout prompt: what changed, what is next, what stays out of the files.}
\item \chg{\textbf{Overleaf, Dropbox, the phone, ChatGPT.} The project folder is on Dropbox, so all four can see it. Show the join, then a file landing in Dropbox.}
\item \chg{\textbf{What else fits.} Obsidian plugins extend the vault. The graph is one example.}
\end{itemize}
\end{frame}
